title: Scalar extension to the condensed algebraic closure is derived faithful
statement: Let X be any scheme [def-pc-scheme], ell a prime, Omega the algebraic closure of Q_ell [def-weil-l-adic-numbers, def-weil-algebraic-closure], and E a finite intermediate field [def-weil-finite-subextension-directed-set]. Use the condensed coefficient rings on the pro-etale site of X of [def-weil-pbc-condensed-e-module-category], in particular the finite-subfield-valued continuous-function condensed Omega. The total left derived extension of scalars from E_X to Omega_X is a faithful functor on the entire unbounded derived categories of internal module objects.

source.place: module docstring, scalar preservation, object descent, and Hom-injectivity paragraphs

proof.text: The injective E-linear inclusion E -> Omega has an algebraic E-linear left inverse r, by LinearMap.leftInverse. Restrict r to any finite intermediate field F and regard it as Q_ell-linear. Finite-dimensionality makes this restriction continuous (LinearMap.continuous_of_finiteDimensional). Every section of the specified condensed Omega takes values in one F, so postcomposition defines a continuous E-valued section and a natural additive section projection. Its E-linearity and retraction equation are pointwise identities.

proof.text: Transfer the pointwise linearity equation through monoidal sheafification and its counit isomorphisms. Apply the strong monoidal inverse image from the profinite point; naturality of its tensor comparison transfers both linearity and the splitting equation to the pro-etale coefficient rings.

proof.text: For a module M, the map S tensor M -> M, s tensor m -> r(s)m, is balanced over R. Its descent is R-linear and natural in M. The scalar-extension unit followed by this retraction is the identity, by r(phi(1))=1. Apply localization to these transformations of complexes: liftNatTrans preserves composition and identities, so the derived identity is a retract of derived extension followed by derived restriction. A retract of a faithful functor in this sense is faithful, as follows immediately from naturality. Exactness from [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-flat-coefficient-calculus] identifies levelwise derived extension with total left derived extension.
